## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (rules: a passing and a failing tree)
- [ ] WCAG mappings use real criteria (number, name, level) with a primary source; `RuleSources.RulesetVersion` bumped if rules or mappings changed
- [ ] No compliance wording ("compliant", "certified", "passes WCAG", "fixed")
- [ ] No real apps, people, devices or personal data in fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Generated docs regenerated if their source changed (docs/limitations.md: `swipewalk limitations`; docs/standards.md: `swipewalk standards`; docs/checks.md: `swipewalk checks`)
